headline: Report: Wild’s Brock Faber expected to make season debut Saturday
take:
Minnesota is 13-3-4 without its best defenceman, and that should worry the rest of the West. Daily Faceoff reports Brock Faber is expected to make his season debut Saturday, after a fractured skull and surgery in the preseason kept him out since September.

The Wild's start is real, mostly. They've taken 55.8% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), which is a contender's share. The part that may not last is in net: their goaltending has allowed 14 fewer goals than the shots deserved. The part that should improve is the finishing, 8.3 goals below what their chances usually produce. Faber, the 2024 Calder runner-up, eats the hard minutes that let everyone else slide down a slot. If the saves cool off, he arrives right when they'll need the chances against to shrink.
